verdict.rationale: LM Studio supports natural-language chat, voice-driven interaction with its Bionic agent, and MCP-based agentic tasks (docs-2, docs-15/16/17, docs-3), suggesting genuine agentic/natural-language operation. However, hands-on reports show rough edges—MCP getting stuck in infinite loops, unclear agent working directories, and a non-obvious model-download flow—indicating the experience is not fully polished for 'command it in natural language and it just works' use.
